name: Lot Ghost
tagline: A jam-band sidekick tracking setlists, tour drops and the daily rumour mill
description: Aimed at Phish and jam-scene obsessives. It follows shows as they happen, sends a short morning wrap of the night before, marks unverified chatter clearly as such, warns you ahead of tickets going on sale, and finishes with a single recording worth putting on. Every claim arrives with a source attached.
author: Bradley
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
